texts.preamble: Goldi S/O Rajendraprasad Gupta vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Ps Kelwad Tq ... on 5 October, 2020 Author: Anil S. Kilor Bench: V.M. Deshpande, Anil S. Kilor 9.apl 1/3 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. Criminal Application (Appp) No. 962 Of 2020 In Criminal Application (Apl) No. 887 Of 2019 (Goldi s/o Rajendraprasad Gupta Vs. State of Maharashtra and anr.) __________________________________________________________________________ Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's orders. and Registrar's Orders.
texts.arguments: Shri Mirza, learned Additional Public Prosecutor points out that this application has been moved on behalf of the State and the Food Safety Officer, making a prayer to vacate the interim order dated 03.09.2019 or in alternative clarify the interim 9.apl887.2019.odt order dated 03.09.2019 and allow the original non- applicant No.2/Food Safety Officer to file the prosecution under Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, against the applicant/accused. 4. Shri Mirza, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has drawn attention of this Court to the orders Goldi S/O Rajendraprasad Gupta vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Ps Kelwad Tq ... Shri Mohta, learned counsel for the non- applicant in this application, is not disputing the fact that in identical matters, this Court permitted the Food Safety Officer to file prosecution under Section 42 of the Act, 2006. However, he points out that in the present matter, the crime has been registered for the offences punishable under Section 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code alongwith the offences under Section 26(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e) and 30(2)(A) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Shri Mirza, learned Additional Public Prosecutor points out that this application has been moved on behalf of the State and the Food Safety Officer, making a prayer to vacate the interim order dated 03.09.2019 or in alternative clarify the interim 9.apl887.2019.odt order dated 03.09.2019 and allow the original non- applicant No.2/Food Safety Officer to file the prosecution under Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, against the applicant/accused. 4. Shri Mirza, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has drawn attention of this Court to the orders Goldi S/O Rajendraprasad Gupta vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Ps Kelwad Tq ... Shri Mohta, learned counsel for the non- applicant in this application, is not disputing the fact that in identical matters, this Court permitted the Food Safety Officer to file prosecution under Section 42 of the Act, 2006. However, he points out that in the present matter, the crime has been registered for the offences punishable under Section 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code alongwith the offences under Section 26(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e) and 30(2)(A) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
